verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Shopify's general app/extension platform (Admin & Storefront APIs, webhooks, extensions validation, UCP/MCP agent tooling) but never mentions Shopify Functions or any serverless-function/hook mechanism specifically for injecting custom discount, shipping, or validation logic that runs inline within checkout or platform processing — webhooks here are explicitly async/near-real-time, not synchronous business-logic hooks. Missing for 10: any documentation of Shopify Functions, function extension points for discounts/shipping/validation, or evidence of in-platform serverless logic execution.
